desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: finished premium board-game videogame screenshot, desktop landscape
Primary request: Redesign Can't Stop as a rich tactile graphical board game, with a prominent DIAMOND-SHAPED board and realistic physical dice. The screen must feel like a premium videogame, with crafted game objects and environmental art.
Reference image: Pantheon screenshot is reference for visual richness, depth, tactile materials, atmospheric light and game-native controls ONLY. Do not copy Greek theme, cards or its layout.
Scene: overhead camera at a very slight angle, warm illuminated walnut gaming table, deep midnight teal felt, cinematic soft lamplight, rich yet controlled material detail. Whole diamond board visible, occupying most of image. No browser chrome or real device frame.
Board: actual rhombus silhouette, one vertex at top, bottom, left and right; aged red enamel or lacquer with dark carved walnut bevel and fine brass edges, readable ivory inset spaces. Eleven parallel tracks, numbered once each 2 through 12 from left to right, vertically centered about the diamond's horizontal equator so BOTH their tops AND bottoms form sloping edges: shortest outer columns 2/12, longest center7. Track lengths 3,5,7,9,11,13,11,9,7,5,3. Do NOT put all track bottoms on one baseline; must read as a diamond, not a mountain triangle, octagon, rectangle or square. Sparse red/teal/gold/violet player pieces and exactly three ivory 3D runners on tracks. Actual wood/resin pieces with bevels, contact shadows and gloss. Number labels engraved along lower sloping edge of board.
Dice: exactly four large realistic translucent ruby-red casino-style rounded cube dice with recessed ivory pips, each clearly showing top values 1,2,5,6, three-dimensional with visible side faces and refraction, resting at natural different angles in near-edge leather-lined tray. No flat rounded squares with drawn dots. The game is about pairing these dice. Near the dice, three small engraved metal pairing tabs '7 + 7', '6 + 8', '3 + 11'; selected7+7 has an amber light and two delicate golden threads linking physical die pairs. Board runner7 shows a restrained destination light.
HUD: four modest portrait/owner medallions and small claim tokens sit at table edges; title 'CAN’T STOP' carved into table corner. Near edge contains two substantial game-native carved action pieces labeled 'MOVE 7 TWICE' and a discreet label '4 steps at risk'. Controls are physical sculpted/brass-inlaid objects resting on table, not flat teal pills. Show a complete polished gameplay composition, legible sparse text only. Board is hero.
Avoid: website, app dashboard, DOM/CSS look, flat wireframes, cards/panels with rounded corners, large rectangular sidebars, header/navigation bars, explanatory paragraphs, charts, blue dashboard backgrounds, vector diagram look, generic RPG clutter, tiny board buried in artwork, excessive ornament behind tracks. Wide 16:10 composition at high resolution.
desktop.referenceRole: Pantheon table for graphical richness and material finish only
